text:
erin: Ran into onboarding chaos this morning. Our ruby sampleapp started 401->refresh storms and then 429s when running with parallel pagination + auth refresh. Repro: spawn 24 workers, prefetch=2.
tom: Which SDK/version?
erin: ruby-sdk 0.3.0-beta; default retry is fixed backoff 300ms x3, no single-flight refresh and no jitter. Logs: ```HTTP/1.1 429 Too Many Requests
x-rate-limit-limit: 18
x-rate-limit-remaining: 0
x-rate-limit-reset: 10```
yasmin: 24*2 in-flight is ~48 concurrent requests. If every worker retries 3x immediately on 401 we easily stampede auth and then quota.
tom: Two quick fixes: add single-flight auth refresh per SDK client and switch retries to exponential + decorrelated jitter. Also cap prefetch by effective concurrency = min(workers, prefetch * workers).
erin: For ruby-sdk I can add a Mutex around refresh and a jitter helper: `sleep = base * 2**attempt * (0.5 + rand)`.
yasmin: Also recommend sampleapp defaults change: workers=8, prefetch=1, onboard_ramp_ms=20000. Add env SKIP_RAMP for power users. Document guidance in onboard README: "ramp, don't blast" with examples.
infra-bot: Observability note: onboarding-ruby-prod hit per-tenant cap at 2026-03-23T07:41:12Z; auto-throttle applied.
devex-bot: Filed issue #1293 "ruby sample: auth single-flight + jittered retries" and assigned to @erin.
erin: I'll open PR with changes + integration test that mocks auth and asserts only one refresh call under churn. Also will include telemetry logging `x-rate-limit-*` headers on failures. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/ruby-onboard-samples/pull/9
tom: Let's also add a cross-sdk checklist to the repo for naming parity: clientConcurrency, prefetchPages, onboardRampMs, retryPolicy. I can draft it.
yasmin: One more runtime idea: SDK should probe /v1/limits on init and seed a leaky-bucket limiter. If header missing, fall back to safe default 10rps. That avoids blind blasting for new customers.
erin: Good point. I'll add a small probe with a 200ms timeout. If it fails, we log but continue with safe defaults.
tom: Thanks. Small changes but should cut down onboarding quota incidents.
